$comment: Raw blind card, rater blind-a. Criterion + probes archived before axes in scratchpad/b8dd77c-blind-a/evidence.txt. Ledger: scratchpad/b8dd77c-blind-a/ledger.txt. Audio unassessed (agent cannot listen).
input: headed Chromium, private X display, ANGLE D3D12 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080), 400x800 @3x, tools/driver.mjs port 5366

horizon.exclusions: driver launch, three page loads (~10 s each), ~1 min note-writing during phases, all card/evidence writing after 00:14:20Z; ~1.5-2 min excluded from 69.9 wall min
deviations: Cold phase was 23 min, not 40: I misjudged elapsed time and took the 20m absence early; compensated with 17 extra active minutes after the 20m return, before the 4h absence.
Post-4h phase was 3.1 min, not 5 (same misjudgement); compensated ~1.9 min in the post-8h phase.
Most watching was at 'fights only' speed; normal-speed watches: 23:09:30-23:13:30, 23:15:34-23:20:30, 00:04:31-00:10:30.
horizon.ruleEditNotes: pen unlocked after Bloat Mother (~19 min in). Completed: hp<30%→return; applied death fix hp<50%→read unknown (later dropped); added/dropped pack break card on forecast; dropped read unknown; applied fix hp<50%·foes≥2→retreat; wrote foe: boss→read silence; WRITE fix reflects melee→reflect read. Attempted-and-reverted: return threshold 50%/40%.

blindnessViolations: none known. Read only RATING.md, FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, FRAMEWORK §0-3, template; glanced at tools/drive.sh and the header comment of tools/driver.mjs for op usage (harness, not game source). Used page.evaluate on visible DOM text/classes only; no engine APIs.
killCriteriaNotes: unfairDeath not flagged but close: at D28 the death screen offered fixes all 'replayed 0-1/12 below bar' and said 'none beats 0/12 as is'; 5 heirs died there.
sameDayRetelling: Iris Ash, my second heir, had been starving out around D13 with only unidentified potions until I spent $26 each on two identified heal potions. That run she cut through the Bloat Mother, the Lich and the Foundry Master and went from my D17 best to D28 carrying $20,922. Then the Lurker Queen's brood surrounded her, my return-at-30% rule found 'no way', and a lurker named Thix killed her at 1 hp (a later heir 'avenged Thix').

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Death trace is precise ('return at 30% · no way ← bloat holds the way'), but several things stayed opaque: the hero hacking down chained captives ('NO FRIENDS ... captive · fell'), 'compare outcomes' never scoring extra tactics, the × that only arms a hidden 'drop', and 'bad luck · 1 in 1' at a wall.

Return threshold showed a real trade-off on the forecast ('death 38→0% · avg $1461→$270' at 40%, 'death 13% · $441' at 30%); buying identified heal potions was decisive. Lapse: at the D28 Queen no option I could find beat the wall ('none beats 0/12 as is'), and slot-2 tactics all forecast worse with no compare.
Learned that heals were 'unknown' and to buy them, then silence scrolls for the Queen; but the curve flattened at D28 for the last ~35 min and both long absences.

Watching 'LURKER QUEEN · OH NO · LURKERS!' with $20922 carried was tense, and carry-at-risk was a chosen stake; most outcomes resolved at fights-only speed or offline, and warlord/mother/lich were never in doubt after the first hour.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Callouts 'SHIELDS UP', 'WARLORD BREAKS', 'SLAIN' land; taps respond instantly. Fights-only auto-speed lurching 1.5x→48x and a ~30 s quiet stretch at fights-only; audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: New biomes changed my rules (Foundry 'iron golem · REFLECTED!' → reflect read; Queen → read silence) and the named grudge 'Thix' returned; but every heir replays the same D8/D13/D18/D23 bosses.
My setup is 'fighter · 3 rules' over shared packages (Guarded, boss focus, deep march); I could not describe it as distinctly mine.
Iris: heal potions → D28, Lich and Master slain, killed by 'Thix' at 1 hp; next report: 'avenged Thix'. Lapse: most other runs had no turn, just the same gauntlet.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: Check-ins short (pick one, upgrade, send). In-run at 1x an event every ~2 s. Drag: identical D1-D23 boss sequence every heir, and many sheets (forge, hero, tactics, supplies, unlocks) each check-in.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: 'fixes · 12 replays of D13 · hp < 50% → read unknown survives 12/12 · was 10/12' with one-tap apply, rule-by-rule why-not trace. Lapse: at D28 it labels the death 'bad luck · 1 in 1' while all fixes are 'below bar'.
Named heirs with traits ('skittish', 'light hands') but no relationship developed.
Chose my own goal (beat the Queen) and tried silence, corridor, pack break, deep march, retreat; large vocabulary ('on see captive', 'tame boss', 'pray for row').
Automation cadence clear: porter, scout, apprentice ('pack 6 · −$2750' while away), keeper, armourer; best D7→D8→D13→D17→D28. Lapse: no depth gain across the 4h and 8h absences ('D28 DEEPEST' both).
Night town with lit windows, the torn 'REPELLED' banner over the warlord, the 'While away' scroll. Lapse: dungeon view at phone size is dark and mostly log text. Audio unassessed.
